name: Vast Suffering
description: Deals additional fixed damage equal to 30% of attack upon dealing damage. Considered a buff, cannot be cleansed.

name: Victory Aura
description: Increases the stability damage dealt by all Electric-type allies by 3 points. When {e290} is triggered, the fixed damage dealt is doubled. When {e487} tile reaction is triggered, gain {e161} for 2 turns.

name: Volley Fire
description: Deals targeted Burn damage that ignores cover equal to 100% of attack and 1 point of stability damage. Each level of Rank increases the damage multiplier by Damage multiplier is increased by 10%. Gains 3 points of Searing Flame and Lewis recovers 1 point of Confectance Index.

name: Voltage
description: Adds Electric weakness to enemy units in the area. When enemy units on the affected tiles suffer AoE damage, a tile reaction is triggered, dealing fixed damage equal to 30% of attack, and removes the tile effect. If the AoE damage is Electric or Hydro, the fixed damage increases to 60% of attack. Deals double damage to large targets. Considered an Electric tile.

name: Voltage Sag
description: Damage dealt is reduced by 5% and Electric damage taken is increased by 6%. Maximum of 3 stacks. Considered an Electric debuff, cannot be cleansed.

name: Vortex
description: Before active attacks resolve, generate Tideway tiles in a 5x5 tile area around the enemy target for 2 turns, and deal fixed damage to the target equal to 40% of Max HP. This effect stacks and all stacks are cleared after this effect triggers. This buff cannot be cleansed.

name: Vulnerability Analysis
description: Hydro damage taken is 2 turns increased by 5%, stacking up to 3 times. Considered a Hydro debuff, cannot be cleansed.

name: Vulnerable I
description: Increase damage taken by 10%. This is considered a defense debuff.

name: Vulnerable II
description: Increase damage taken by 20%. This is considered a defense debuff.

name: Waking Ricochet
description:
Alternately triggers the active skill Dreamquake and the basic attack Bedtime Warmup.

Before the attack, applies {e468} to all enemy units within range for 1 turn.

The range of Dreamquake is increased by 2 tiles and the damage multiplier of Bedtime Warmup is increased to 130%.

name: Warding Light
description: Increase Freeze damage dealt by 15%.

name: Weakness Piercing
description: When dealing Physical damage, ignores 5% of the target's defense. Can be stacked, considered a buff, cannot be cleansed.

name: Wear and Tear
description: Attack is reduced by 30% and mobility is reduced by 3 tiles. Considered a debuff, cannot be cleansed.

name: Wellflow
description: Max HP increased by 10%. Considered a Hydro buff, cannot be cleansed.

name: Whippoorwill Pulse
description: Deals AoE Burn damage equal to 40% of attack to all enemy units within 5 tiles, cleanses 1 debuff from all allied units, restores 2 points of stability and grants 3 points of {e387} to them.

name: Whirlwind
description: Gain 6 tiles of extra mobility, and allow for the use of Blade Whirlwind.

name: Whisper
description: Damage taken is increased by 10%. Can be stacked, considered a debuff, cannot be cleansed. When Whisper is applied, if the subject's HP is 100% or more or if their HP is restored to 100% or more of their max HP, removes Whisper and gains {e150} for 2 rounds.

name: Wide-Area Condensation
description: If this unit has 5 stacks of this effect after making an active attack, expend all stacks and gain 1 instance of Extra Action, stacking up to 5 times. This buff cannot be cleansed.

name: Winterfrost Drive
description: For each stack of this effect, Freeze damage dealt by this unit is increased by 20%, up to a maximum increase of 60%. Considered a buff, cannot be cleansed.

name: Wintry Bastion
description: Reduce damage taken by 30%, maximum of 5 stacks. Expend 1 stack upon being attacked. This is considered a Freeze buff and cannot be cleansed.

name: Wok Hei
description: Burn damage dealt is increased by 7% and damage taken is reduced by 7%. Stacks up to 4 times. Considered a Burn buff, cannot be cleansed.

name: Wolf's Eye
description: When an enemy unit within 8 tiles attempts to move, attack, or at the end of the action, perform 1 instance of Lock-On Attack, dealing physical damage ignoring cover equal to 80% of attack and 1 point of stability damage to enemy targets within 3x3 tiles area, triggering 1 time per target. This effect can be triggered up to 6 times per round.

name: Zoom In
description: Increase damage dealt by 15%, and increase stability damage by 2 points. This stacks up to 2 time and is effective once. This buff cannot be cleansed.
